name: cockpit
description: One band above the prompt with Clawd, the Claude Code mascot, who reacts to what is happening: context, cache, 5-hour and weekly limits, tools at work, finished turns, permission prompts. Collapsed row of meters with an expand arrow, a speech bubble with the button for every warning, saver routing, preflight warnings, the prompt enhancer, and a chime. Replaces meters, saver, preflight-guard and prompt-enhancer.

warnPercent.title: First context warning (%)
warnPercent.description: The context bar turns orange and warns that quality may start to slip.

redPercent.title: Context alert (%)
redPercent.description: The context bar turns red past this.

warnTokens.title: Context warning by size (tokens)
warnTokens.description: Same orange warning once the context holds this many tokens, whatever the percent (a 1M window).

cacheMinutes.title: Prompt cache window (minutes)
cacheMinutes.description: Used until the real window is learned from the API's behaviour, or when you set one with /cache <minutes>.

notifyMinutes.title: Warn before the cache goes cold (minutes)
notifyMinutes.description: A notice this long before the prompt cache expires. Capped at half the window.

cacheStepMinutes.title: Cache countdown steps (minutes)
cacheStepMinutes.description: The countdown redraws every this many minutes (55m, 50m, ...). It resets to the full window each time you send a message.

handoffKey.title: Hotkey: new session with handoff
handoffKey.description: Chord pressed in the prompt box, e.g. meta+h. Empty turns it off.

freshKey.title: Hotkey: fresh session
freshKey.description: Chord pressed in the prompt box, e.g. meta+n. Empty turns it off.

sound.title: Chime when a turn finishes
sound.description: Plays sounds/done.wav at the end of each main-loop turn (macOS afplay, Windows PowerShell).

turnLog.title: Log each turn to a local file
turnLog.description: One line per finished turn (tokens, model, duration, routed, context %) in ~/.claude/cockpit-log/<session>.jsonl, for your own review with tools/cockpit-log.py. Nothing is sent anywhere.

hotkey.title: Enhance hotkey
hotkey.description: Chord pressed in the prompt box, e.g. meta+e (Option+E on macOS terminals set to use Option as Meta), ctrl+shift+e. Empty turns the hotkey off.

model.title: Model that rewrites the draft
model.description: An alias (haiku, sonnet) or a full model id. A small model keeps each Enhance cheap.

enhanceStyle.title: Enhance style
enhanceStyle.description: full (task, skills, project context, questions, done criteria, about 350 words) or lean (task, up to 2 questions, done criteria, about 120 words). Your main model reads the result on every send, so lean costs fewer tokens.

maxSkills.title: Skills offered to the model
maxSkills.description: At most this many installed skills are sent with the draft, the best word matches first.

mascot.title: Clawd's size
mascot.description: normal (68 x 56 px), small (34 x 28 px) or off. /cockpit mascot changes it from the prompt and remembers it.

askSeconds.title: Raised hand delay (seconds)
askSeconds.description: A permission ask must stay open this long before Clawd raises the clipboard. Longer means fewer false alarms when a rule or the mode settles the ask.
